controls.publicSnapshot: Ed25519 signed response body with SHA-256 Content-Digest
controls.scheduledRefresh: 32-byte secret, constant-time comparison, internal Cron only
controls.writeAuthentication: HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp, nonce, and exact request body
controls.replayProtection: five-minute request window and 24-hour D1 nonce retention
controls.writeRateLimit: 60 requests per minute per network-address and signer pair
controls.inputValidation: 256 KiB maximum, strict source and Solana identifier validation
controls.reserveQuorum: two distinct configured signers must attest to an identical normalized report
controls.onchainReconciliation: attested reserve quantities, USDC and share supply must match the public Squads Vault within 10 bps
controls.oracleQuorum: two external Ed25519 attestations over the exact signed index digest
